• At least two references must come from mathematics faculty.
• Fall 2027 fee remains unconfirmed by the central rate table.
• The 2026-27 catalog lists Yat Sun Poon as emeritus, unlike his older profile. John Baez, Mei-Chu Chang,
Zhuang-dan Guan and Bun Wong are also emeriti. The old department Publications index is not a reliable
current appointment roster. The UCR mathematician Kevin Costello is a Professor of Teaching; do not confuse
him with the Perimeter Institute researcher.
• Faculty below form a verified research-fit shortlist, not a complete census. New-student supervision and 2027
leave/moves must be confirmed; paper dates describe the cited version.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Accredited bachelor’s degree and GPA 3.0. Mathematics requires six quarter courses or four semester courses
of upper-division proof-based mathematics, covering suitable algebra, analysis, topology, differential
equations, numerical analysis, or probability. Planned/in-progress courses completed before graduation can
count. International UChicago applicants can apply. [s2] [s4]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Apply to Mathematics PhD for fall; prepare a mathematics course list with descriptions and textbooks and
arrange three referees, including at least two mathematics faculty. Current requirements should be used
instead of the old /grads/apply/ pages. [s1] [s2]
Adviser contact [Unresolved]
Mathematics graduate administrative contact: mathadmin@ucr.edu (Kathryn Aquino on the support page). No
mandatory prior adviser agreement was found. [s10]
Portal workflow [2027 confirmed]
Applications for Fall 2027 opened September 1, 2026. Enter referee details to send invitations before
submission. After submission, applicants can upload corrected/updated materials and monitor receipt and
decisions; personal information can carry forward from a prior application, but reference reuse is not promised.
[s4] [s6]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Current mathematics deadline page explicitly covers Fall 2027; central application instructions include the
revised combined SOP. Old /grads/apply/ pages contain materially conflicting requirements. [s1] [s4] [s8] [s9]

sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Central minimum old TOEFL 80/new 4.0 or IELTS 7 with each section 6. Tests must remain valid within two
years at enrollment. TOEFL MyBest and IELTS One Skill Retake are not accepted; TOEFL Home and IELTS Online
are accepted. TA English eligibility is a separate employment requirement. [s4]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
An applicant who has earned OR WILL EARN a bachelor’s or higher degree from a US institution where
instruction is solely in English meets the degree exemption. This explicitly covers an expected UChicago
degree, subject to completion. TA employment language rules remain separate. [s4]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Neither required nor considered; the department says submitted GRE scores are not viewable in its application
review. Older pages claiming a required general GRE are superseded. [s2] [s3]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three required; at least two must be mathematics faculty under the department’s rule. All letters must be in
English. Extra letters are discouraged centrally. [s2] [s4]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
This specific reference detail was not established by the public program/graduate application instructions
checked. Confirm it in the current referee-help screen or with admissions before entering contacts; no
invitation was triggered during research. [s2] [s4] [s5]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
As soon as referee contact information is confirmed/saved, the system emails the personalized upload link.
Choose FERPA access before sending; it cannot subsequently be changed for that request. [s4] [s5]
Before versus after submission [Conflict]
Invitations are independent of final application submission and may be sent beforehand. The old department
claim that payment/submission must occur first is stale. [s4] [s8]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Each received letter triggers an email confirmation and is shown on the application status page. [s5] [s6]

Applicant can remind, exclude, or add a referee. Incorrect contact details require excluding and re-adding the
person; FERPA selection cannot be edited after sending. Interfolio is accepted. Replacement of an already
submitted letter and cross-cycle reuse are not established. [s5]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
Most mathematics PhD admits receive stipend/salary plus tuition, fees, and health coverage, but no exact
annual 2027-28 stipend was established. Distinguish the actual offer from general support descriptions. UC
Article 35, Table B.1, sets the Group 1 quarter-system 50% TA salary at USD 4,278/month at point 1 from
October 1, 2027 (points 2/3: 4,449/4,582). UCSC and UCR fall in Group 1. Nine paid months at point 1 would
total USD 38,502 by arithmetic; this is a negotiated wage scale, not a verified mathematics annual package,
funded-month promise, net stipend or summer guarantee. Confirm appointment fraction, starting point, dates
and supplements in the offer. [s3] [s10] [ucwages2027]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Most admitted PhD students receive 15 quarters, equivalent to five academic years, of multiyear support
subject to conditions. Summer support is not established by that quarter count. [s3]
International eligibility [Unresolved]
Department support is offered to international PhD students through the same multiyear framework; confirm
all nonresident tuition and TA language provisions in the individual offer. Citizenship eligibility for particular
supplemental fellowships is unverified. [s3] [s10]
Conditions and duties [Unresolved]
Satisfactory academic progress and assistantship duties apply; precise renewal, teaching load, and summer
terms must be checked in the offer. [s3] [s10]
Extra funding application [Conflict]
Current central process has the program forward any fellowship nomination with its admission
recommendation. No universal separate mathematics funding form is identified on the current checklist. Older
pages mention domestic fellowship forms; current applicability is unverified. [s2] [s6] [s8]
Other funding routes [Unresolved]
This particular funding term was not established by the public program/admissions material checked. Obtain
the exact rule in the funding offer or from the graduate coordinator; neither eligibility nor a guaranteed
amount/duration is inferred from silence. [s2] [s4] [s5]
Application fee [Prior cycle]
Central page lists USD 155 international/USD 135 domestic, but explicitly labels that rate Summer 2024
through Spring 2027. The Fall 2027 rate is therefore not confirmed by this statement. [s4]
Fee waiver [2027 confirmed]
The 2027-28 central waiver is limited to US citizens, permanent residents, or undocumented applicants, so this
F-1 applicant is ineligible. Mathematics advertises graduate-fair fee discounts via emailed instructions;
international applicability is unverified. Central eligible applicants must request at least five business days
before priority, allowing holiday closures. [s3] [s7]

Pay attention to
• Use current pages, not the stale /grads/apply/ route.
• GRE scores are neither required nor considered.
• Single combined SOP, maximum 2,000 words; old separate-essay instructions are superseded.
• At least two references must come from mathematics faculty.
• Fall 2027 fee remains unconfirmed by the central rate table.
• The 2026-27 catalog lists Yat Sun Poon as emeritus, unlike his older profile. John Baez, Mei-Chu Chang,
Zhuang-dan Guan and Bun Wong are also emeriti. The old department Publications index is not a reliable
current appointment roster. The UCR mathematician Kevin Costello is a Professor of Teaching; do not confuse
him with the Perimeter Institute researcher.
• Faculty below form a verified research-fit shortlist, not a complete census. New-student supervision and 2027
leave/moves must be confirmed; paper dates describe the cited version.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Accredited bachelor’s degree and GPA 3.0. Mathematics requires six quarter courses or four semester courses
of upper-division proof-based mathematics, covering suitable algebra, analysis, topology, differential
equations, numerical analysis, or probability. Planned/in-progress courses completed before graduation can
count. International UChicago applicants can apply. [s2] [s4]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Apply to Mathematics PhD for fall; prepare a mathematics course list with descriptions and textbooks and
arrange three referees, including at least two mathematics faculty. Current requirements should be used
instead of the old /grads/apply/ pages. [s1] [s2]
Adviser contact [Unresolved]
Mathematics graduate administrative contact: mathadmin@ucr.edu (Kathryn Aquino on the support page). No
mandatory prior adviser agreement was found. [s10]
Portal workflow [2027 confirmed]
Applications for Fall 2027 opened September 1, 2026. Enter referee details to send invitations before
submission. After submission, applicants can upload corrected/updated materials and monitor receipt and
decisions; personal information can carry forward from a prior application, but reference reuse is not promised.
[s4] [s6]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Current mathematics deadline page explicitly covers Fall 2027; central application instructions include the
revised combined SOP. Old /grads/apply/ pages contain materially conflicting requirements. [s1] [s4] [s8] [s9]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
Priority December 14, 2026; final January 5, 2027 for Fall 2027 PhD admission. Time of day/timezone not
published on the checked department page. [s1]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Priority December 14, 2026; fellowship consideration continues through the January 5, 2027 final deadline.
Submit a complete application by priority for strongest consideration. [s1]
Reference receipt; Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
All supporting materials must be received by January 5, 2027; complete by December 14, 2026 for priority
consideration. No mathematics-specific later grace period found. [s1]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Applicable evidence should be complete by the program deadline. Unofficial test results are accepted initially;
official results are required if admitted and accepting the offer. GRE scores are not considered. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No binding program-wide acceptance deadline for Fall 2027 was established in the public admissions pages
checked. Use the individual offer and ask the program if unclear; do not infer April 15 merely from an earlier
CGS signatory list. [s2] [s4] [s5]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Central minimum old TOEFL 80/new 4.0 or IELTS 7 with each section 6. Tests must remain valid within two
years at enrollment. TOEFL MyBest and IELTS One Skill Retake are not accepted; TOEFL Home and IELTS Online
are accepted. TA English eligibility is a separate employment requirement. [s4]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
An applicant who has earned OR WILL EARN a bachelor’s or higher degree from a US institution where
instruction is solely in English meets the degree exemption. This explicitly covers an expected UChicago
degree, subject to completion. TA employment language rules remain separate. [s4]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Neither required nor considered; the department says submitted GRE scores are not viewable in its application
review. Older pages claiming a required general GRE are superseded. [s2] [s3]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload unofficial records from all college-level institutions, showing name, institution, attendance, grades,
credits, grading legend, and any awarded degree. Do not send official records unless requested. WES ICAP
after acceptance applies to foreign degrees, not UChicago. [s4]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Required mathematics course list with brief descriptions and textbooks. [s2]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Brief descriptions and textbooks are explicitly required in the mathematics course list; public page does not
prescribe a length or file template. [s2]

Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three required; at least two must be mathematics faculty under the department’s rule. All letters must be in
English. Extra letters are discouraged centrally. [s2] [s4]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
This specific reference detail was not established by the public program/graduate application instructions
checked. Confirm it in the current referee-help screen or with admissions before entering contacts; no
invitation was triggered during research. [s2] [s4] [s5]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
As soon as referee contact information is confirmed/saved, the system emails the personalized upload link.
Choose FERPA access before sending; it cannot subsequently be changed for that request. [s4] [s5]
Before versus after submission [Conflict]
Invitations are independent of final application submission and may be sent beforehand. The old department
claim that payment/submission must occur first is stale. [s4] [s8]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Each received letter triggers an email confirmation and is shown on the application status page. [s5] [s6]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Applicant can remind, exclude, or add a referee. Incorrect contact details require excluding and re-adding the
person; FERPA selection cannot be edited after sending. Interfolio is accepted. Replacement of an already
submitted letter and cross-cycle reuse are not established. [s5]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Unresolved]
A separate CV is not listed on the current mathematics checklist. Central application includes Relevant
Experience; whether that section requires a CV upload is not established. [s2] [s4]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required single Graduate Statement of Purpose, maximum 2,000 words. Faithful paraphrase of six areas:
academic/professional preparation; research/professional interests; fit with UCR faculty/resources; motivation
now and long-term aims; intended scholarly or public contribution; and leadership, collaboration, mentoring, or
outreach. Upload to the application. Font, margins, and file-size rules were not publicly established. [s4]
Personal / background statement [Conflict]
Current central instructions use one combined Graduate Statement of Purpose beginning with Summer/Fall
2026. A separate Personal History Statement appears only on the older mathematics route; do not draft it as
mandatory without a current portal prompt. [s4] [s8]
Research-interest statement [Unresolved]
Discuss research interests within the required combined SOP; no separate current mathematics
research-interest document was found. [s2] [s4]
Research proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary; Publications list; Scholarship
essays [Unresolved]
The public mathematics and graduate-admissions pages checked do not establish a separate requirement or
permission to submit this item. Required/optional status, exact prompt, length, formatting and
upload-versus-link instructions remain unverified; check the current portal before drafting or sending an extra
document. [s2] [s4] [s5]

Required upload/list of mathematics courses with brief descriptions and textbooks. Exact template, word/page

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
Most mathematics PhD admits receive stipend/salary plus tuition, fees, and health coverage, but no exact
annual 2027-28 stipend was established. Distinguish the actual offer from general support descriptions. UC
Article 35, Table B.1, sets the Group 1 quarter-system 50% TA salary at USD 4,278/month at point 1 from
October 1, 2027 (points 2/3: 4,449/4,582). UCSC and UCR fall in Group 1. Nine paid months at point 1 would
total USD 38,502 by arithmetic; this is a negotiated wage scale, not a verified mathematics annual package,
funded-month promise, net stipend or summer guarantee. Confirm appointment fraction, starting point, dates
and supplements in the offer. [s3] [s10] [ucwages2027]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Most admitted PhD students receive 15 quarters, equivalent to five academic years, of multiyear support
subject to conditions. Summer support is not established by that quarter count. [s3]
International eligibility [Unresolved]
Department support is offered to international PhD students through the same multiyear framework; confirm
all nonresident tuition and TA language provisions in the individual offer. Citizenship eligibility for particular
supplemental fellowships is unverified. [s3] [s10]
Conditions and duties [Unresolved]
Satisfactory academic progress and assistantship duties apply; precise renewal, teaching load, and summer
terms must be checked in the offer. [s3] [s10]
Extra funding application [Conflict]
Current central process has the program forward any fellowship nomination with its admission
recommendation. No universal separate mathematics funding form is identified on the current checklist. Older
pages mention domestic fellowship forms; current applicability is unverified. [s2] [s6] [s8]
Other funding routes [Unresolved]
This particular funding term was not established by the public program/admissions material checked. Obtain
the exact rule in the funding offer or from the graduate coordinator; neither eligibility nor a guaranteed
amount/duration is inferred from silence. [s2] [s4] [s5]
Application fee [Prior cycle]
Central page lists USD 155 international/USD 135 domestic, but explicitly labels that rate Summer 2024
through Spring 2027. The Fall 2027 rate is therefore not confirmed by this statement. [s4]
Fee waiver [2027 confirmed]
The 2027-28 central waiver is limited to US citizens, permanent residents, or undocumented applicants, so this
F-1 applicant is ineligible. Mathematics advertises graduate-fair fee discounts via emailed instructions;
international applicability is unverified. Central eligible applicants must request at least five business days
before priority, allowing holiday closures. [s3] [s7]

Pay attention to
• Use current pages, not the stale /grads/apply/ route.
• GRE scores are neither required nor considered.
• Single combined SOP, maximum 2,000 words; old separate-essay instructions are superseded.
• At least two references must come from mathematics faculty.
• Fall 2027 fee remains unconfirmed by the central rate table.
• The 2026-27 catalog lists Yat Sun Poon as emeritus, unlike his older profile. John Baez, Mei-Chu Chang,
Zhuang-dan Guan and Bun Wong are also emeriti. The old department Publications index is not a reliable
current appointment roster. The UCR mathematician Kevin Costello is a Professor of Teaching; do not confuse
him with the Perimeter Institute researcher.
• Faculty below form a verified research-fit shortlist, not a complete census. New-student supervision and 2027
leave/moves must be confirmed; paper dates describe the cited version.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Accredited bachelor’s degree and GPA 3.0. Mathematics requires six quarter courses or four semester courses
of upper-division proof-based mathematics, covering suitable algebra, analysis, topology, differential
equations, numerical analysis, or probability. Planned/in-progress courses completed before graduation can
count. International UChicago applicants can apply. [s2] [s4]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Apply to Mathematics PhD for fall; prepare a mathematics course list with descriptions and textbooks and
arrange three referees, including at least two mathematics faculty. Current requirements should be used
instead of the old /grads/apply/ pages. [s1] [s2]
Adviser contact [Unresolved]
Mathematics graduate administrative contact: mathadmin@ucr.edu (Kathryn Aquino on the support page). No
mandatory prior adviser agreement was found. [s10]
Portal workflow [2027 confirmed]
Applications for Fall 2027 opened September 1, 2026. Enter referee details to send invitations before
submission. After submission, applicants can upload corrected/updated materials and monitor receipt and
decisions; personal information can carry forward from a prior application, but reference reuse is not promised.
[s4] [s6]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Current mathematics deadline page explicitly covers Fall 2027; central application instructions include the
revised combined SOP. Old /grads/apply/ pages contain materially conflicting requirements. [s1] [s4] [s8] [s9]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
Priority December 14, 2026; final January 5, 2027 for Fall 2027 PhD admission. Time of day/timezone not
published on the checked department page. [s1]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Priority December 14, 2026; fellowship consideration continues through the January 5, 2027 final deadline.
Submit a complete application by priority for strongest consideration. [s1]
Reference receipt; Supporting documents [2027 confirmed]
All supporting materials must be received by January 5, 2027; complete by December 14, 2026 for priority
consideration. No mathematics-specific later grace period found. [s1]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Applicable evidence should be complete by the program deadline. Unofficial test results are accepted initially;
official results are required if admitted and accepting the offer. GRE scores are not considered. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No binding program-wide acceptance deadline for Fall 2027 was established in the public admissions pages
checked. Use the individual offer and ask the program if unclear; do not infer April 15 merely from an earlier
CGS signatory list. [s2] [s4] [s5]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
Central minimum old TOEFL 80/new 4.0 or IELTS 7 with each section 6. Tests must remain valid within two
years at enrollment. TOEFL MyBest and IELTS One Skill Retake are not accepted; TOEFL Home and IELTS Online
are accepted. TA English eligibility is a separate employment requirement. [s4]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
An applicant who has earned OR WILL EARN a bachelor’s or higher degree from a US institution where
instruction is solely in English meets the degree exemption. This explicitly covers an expected UChicago
degree, subject to completion. TA employment language rules remain separate. [s4]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Neither required nor considered; the department says submitted GRE scores are not viewable in its application
review. Older pages claiming a required general GRE are superseded. [s2] [s3]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload unofficial records from all college-level institutions, showing name, institution, attendance, grades,
credits, grading legend, and any awarded degree. Do not send official records unless requested. WES ICAP
after acceptance applies to foreign degrees, not UChicago. [s4]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
Required mathematics course list with brief descriptions and textbooks. [s2]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Brief descriptions and textbooks are explicitly required in the mathematics course list; public page does not
prescribe a length or file template. [s2]

Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three required; at least two must be mathematics faculty under the department’s rule. All letters must be in
English. Extra letters are discouraged centrally. [s2] [s4]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
This specific reference detail was not established by the public program/graduate application instructions
checked. Confirm it in the current referee-help screen or with admissions before entering contacts; no
invitation was triggered during research. [s2] [s4] [s5]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
As soon as referee contact information is confirmed/saved, the system emails the personalized upload link.
Choose FERPA access before sending; it cannot subsequently be changed for that request. [s4] [s5]
Before versus after submission [Conflict]
Invitations are independent of final application submission and may be sent beforehand. The old department
claim that payment/submission must occur first is stale. [s4] [s8]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Each received letter triggers an email confirmation and is shown on the application status page. [s5] [s6]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Applicant can remind, exclude, or add a referee. Incorrect contact details require excluding and re-adding the
person; FERPA selection cannot be edited after sending. Interfolio is accepted. Replacement of an already
submitted letter and cross-cycle reuse are not established. [s5]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Unresolved]
A separate CV is not listed on the current mathematics checklist. Central application includes Relevant
Experience; whether that section requires a CV upload is not established. [s2] [s4]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required single Graduate Statement of Purpose, maximum 2,000 words. Faithful paraphrase of six areas:
academic/professional preparation; research/professional interests; fit with UCR faculty/resources; motivation
now and long-term aims; intended scholarly or public contribution; and leadership, collaboration, mentoring, or
outreach. Upload to the application. Font, margins, and file-size rules were not publicly established. [s4]
Personal / background statement [Conflict]
Current central instructions use one combined Graduate Statement of Purpose beginning with Summer/Fall
2026. A separate Personal History Statement appears only on the older mathematics route; do not draft it as
mandatory without a current portal prompt. [s4] [s8]
Research-interest statement [Unresolved]
Discuss research interests within the required combined SOP; no separate current mathematics
research-interest document was found. [s2] [s4]
Research proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary; Publications list; Scholarship
essays [Unresolved]
The public mathematics and graduate-admissions pages checked do not establish a separate requirement or
permission to submit this item. Required/optional status, exact prompt, length, formatting and
upload-versus-link instructions remain unverified; check the current portal before drafting or sending an extra
document. [s2] [s4] [s5]

Course-list document [Standing rule]
Required upload/list of mathematics courses with brief descriptions and textbooks. Exact template, word/page
limit, and file format are not published on the current department page. [s2]
Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
Central application includes Relevant Experience. Exact current short-answer prompts and character limits are
portal-only or were not located. [s4]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
Most mathematics PhD admits receive stipend/salary plus tuition, fees, and health coverage, but no exact
annual 2027-28 stipend was established. Distinguish the actual offer from general support descriptions. UC
Article 35, Table B.1, sets the Group 1 quarter-system 50% TA salary at USD 4,278/month at point 1 from
October 1, 2027 (points 2/3: 4,449/4,582). UCSC and UCR fall in Group 1. Nine paid months at point 1 would
total USD 38,502 by arithmetic; this is a negotiated wage scale, not a verified mathematics annual package,
funded-month promise, net stipend or summer guarantee. Confirm appointment fraction, starting point, dates
and supplements in the offer. [s3] [s10] [ucwages2027]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Most admitted PhD students receive 15 quarters, equivalent to five academic years, of multiyear support
subject to conditions. Summer support is not established by that quarter count. [s3]
International eligibility [Unresolved]
Department support is offered to international PhD students through the same multiyear framework; confirm
all nonresident tuition and TA language provisions in the individual offer. Citizenship eligibility for particular
supplemental fellowships is unverified. [s3] [s10]
Conditions and duties [Unresolved]
Satisfactory academic progress and assistantship duties apply; precise renewal, teaching load, and summer
terms must be checked in the offer. [s3] [s10]
Extra funding application [Conflict]
Current central process has the program forward any fellowship nomination with its admission
recommendation. No universal separate mathematics funding form is identified on the current checklist. Older
pages mention domestic fellowship forms; current applicability is unverified. [s2] [s6] [s8]
Other funding routes [Unresolved]
This particular funding term was not established by the public program/admissions material checked. Obtain
the exact rule in the funding offer or from the graduate coordinator; neither eligibility nor a guaranteed
amount/duration is inferred from silence. [s2] [s4] [s5]
Application fee [Prior cycle]
Central page lists USD 155 international/USD 135 domestic, but explicitly labels that rate Summer 2024
through Spring 2027. The Fall 2027 rate is therefore not confirmed by this statement. [s4]
Fee waiver [2027 confirmed]
The 2027-28 central waiver is limited to US citizens, permanent residents, or undocumented applicants, so this
F-1 applicant is ineligible. Mathematics advertises graduate-fair fee discounts via emailed instructions;
international applicability is unverified. Central eligible applicants must request at least five business days
before priority, allowing holiday closures. [s3] [s7]

Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Old pages claim GPA 3.20, required general GRE, two essays, and reference invitations only after paid
submission. Current pages state GPA 3.0, no GRE consideration, one combined SOP, and immediate referee
invitations on saving. Old international May 1 deadlines must not replace the current January 5 final PhD
deadline. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s8] [s9]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm Fall 2027 fee; exact stipend, summer and nonresident tuition coverage; offer response date; whether
Relevant Experience needs a CV; scholarship short answers; course-list format; TA English requirements; and
submitted-letter update/reuse policies. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s4] [s5] [s10]
